principle_violations.reason: The PaymentProcessor interface forces implementations to provide an auth_sms method even if they don't need it. This violates the Interface Segregation Principle as the class unnecessarily exposes behavior that is not relevant to all payment processors.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the authentication functionality into another interface, such as SMSAuthentication, and implement it where necessary.

principle_violations.reason: The Order class is responsible for managing items, quantities, and prices as well as handling the order status, leading to multiple responsibilities being handled within one class.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the order status management into another class such as OrderStatusManager, and delegate the status functionality to it.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
